name: companion-atlas
description: Companion Atlas — 4D spatial storytelling viewer for the Companion Intelligence suite (formerly Companion Earth).

scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/story-schema && npm run dev -w viewer-react
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/story-schema && npm run build -w viewer-react
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/story-schema && npm test -w viewer-react && npm test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/story-schema && npm run typecheck -w server
